text:
maya: Postmortem follow-up: summary and concrete action list for streaming/chat reliability (timeouts, partial responses, reconnect flow). Keeping it tight so we can schedule the remediation sprint.

trent: I'll take client reconnect/backoff defaults + handshake retry behavior on the server. Plan: RFC PR for config + tests by 2026-03-31, implement in SDK/runtime by 2026-04-05, canary 2026-04-07. Proposed defaults: exponential backoff, capped attempts 5, small jitter.

sophia: Observability owner here. Work items: 1) add metric stream.partial_rate per model+route, 2) expose handshake latency p50/p95/p99, 3) create alert: partial_rate > 0.4% for 10m or spike to >1% instant. Will also add a dashboard with request id drilldowns. Target: 2026-03-29.

li: I'll build a replay harness that simulates flaky networks and truncated chunks (partial responses). Deliverables: deterministic CI job that runs nightly, a minimal repro script to attach to the ticket, and a set of golden traces for regression detection. Target: 2026-03-27.

trent: Quick sample config (for feedback):
```json
{
  "streaming": {
    "client_reconnect": {
      "enabled": true,
      "strategy": "exp",
      "initial_ms": 80,
      "max_ms": 1600,
      "max_attempts": 5,
      "jitter_fraction": 0.15
    }
  }
}
```
This should be safe for default customers but tunable.

ops-bot: Created tickets RW-STREAM-829 (reconnect defaults, owner: trent), RW-STREAM-830 (telemetry + alerts, owner: sophia), RW-STREAM-831 (repro harness + CI, owner: li).

maya: Server-side short-circuit behavior needs to be deterministic: when a request hits repeated partials above threshold, mark it with "partial_shortcircuit=true", immediately trigger safe-fallback logic (no progressive retries), and persist the request's KV snapshot to logs for 60s for postmortem. Also require product-facing blurb before customer-visible canary.

sophia: Will tag logs with event=partial_shortcircuit and add a trace correlation span. Dashboard will show the KV snapshot link for triage. Also adding a playbook step: on alert fire, attach sample request IDs and kick a paging contact.

trent: Noted potential runtime interaction: continuous batching may cause larger-batch handshake timeouts if clients reconnect frequently. I'll sync with eng-runtime tomorrow and add a check to prevent reconnect storms from reducing batch throughput.

canary-bot: Planned canary window: 2026-04-07 03:00-07:00 UTC, region: us-west2. Rollback if partial_rate > 0.9% or handshake p99 increases by >120ms.

maya: Closing criteria proposal: PRs merged + canary stable for 48h with partial_rate reduction vs baseline, enhanced telemetry retained 2 weeks, then retrospective and mark actions closed. Also pair with growth for customer comms draft before canary.

li: ACK 33 I'll attach the minimal repro and nightly CI config to RW-STREAM-831.

sophia: ACK 33 linking dashboard + alerts to RW-STREAM-830 before canary.

trent: ACK 33 opening RFC now and will link to RW-STREAM-829.

maya: Thanks team 33 15m sync Friday to verify readiness.
